    boolean bellmanFord(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(distArr, INF);
        distArr[s] = 0;
        head = tail = 0;
        enqueue(s);
        while (tail > 0) {
            int u = dequeue();

                    int h = h_ >> 1;

                    int v_ = u ^ UVArr[h];

                        distArr[v_] = p;

        int flow = INF;
        for (int u = t, h_, h; u != s; u ^= UVArr[h]) {
            h = (h_ = parentIdx[u]) >> 1;

        for (int u = t, h_, h; u != s; u ^= UVArr[h]) {
